challenges.name: tuition-rules-switch
challenges.title: Rewrite the tuition rules with switch expressions
challenges.description: Sen Academy's tuition rules lived in an if/else chain and a switch statement with a default branch: the 3-sibling discount was unreachable for a year, and online classes were billed 0 VND for two weeks. Rewrite them as switch expressions: BasePrice per class kind (Group, Private, Online, Camp), DiscountPercent from volume and sibling rules with property and relational patterns and a 20% cap, and Bill, which skips enrollments without sessions. The test runner reads one enrollment per line and prints each bill.

tests.name: The example: group, group with a sibling, private
tests.input:
HS-1024 Group 8 1
HS-1025 Group 12 2
HS-1026 Private 8 1
tests.expected:

HS-1025 Group: 1440000 VND (base 1800000, discount 20%)
HS-1026 Private: 3040000 VND (base 3200000, discount 5%)
